name: Fish Welfare Africa
summary: Nairobi-based member of the Aquatic Animal Alliance focused on farmed and wild-caught fish. Its stated work includes engaging farmers on fish sentience and researching welfare on farms.
notes: The alliance’s member roster links directly to the organisation’s public profile. No standalone homepage was identified.

name: Asociación para el Rescate y Bienestar de los Animales
summary: Co-leads Pulpos Libres Perú, a campaign to prevent octopus farming in Peru. It also seeks cage-free egg commitments and teaches responsible companion-animal care.

sources.title: Pulpos Libres Peru — AQUATIC ANIMAL ALLIANCE

name: AnimaNaturalis
summary: Animal rights organisation active in Spain and Latin America. It has investigated conditions on Spanish rainbow trout farms and joined the Mexican coalition seeking a ban on commercial octopus farming.

sources.title: Four Years of Evidence-Based Advocacy Behind Mexico's Octopus Farming Ban Bill — AQUATIC ANIMAL ALLIANCE

name: Te Protejo
summary: Certifies products made without animal testing and promotes alternatives to animal research in Latin America. It co-leads a campaign against octopus farming in Peru and joined a similar coalition in Mexico.

sources.title: Pulpos Libres Peru — AQUATIC ANIMAL ALLIANCE
Four Years of Evidence-Based Advocacy Behind Mexico's Octopus Farming Ban Bill — AQUATIC ANIMAL ALLIANCE

name: Tambuyog Development Center
summary: Philippine fisheries and coastal development organisation. Its Milkfish Welfare Project works with farmers to improve rearing practices and build awareness of fish welfare.

sources.title: Tambuyog Development Centre: Advancing Milkfish Welfare

name: Centre for Marinelife Conservation and Community Development
summary: Vietnamese coastal conservation organisation that works with Mekong Delta producers, businesses and local government on welfare standards and farming practices for shrimp and fish.

sources.title: Centre for Marinelife Conservation and Community Development

name: Aquatic Initiative for Restoration
summary: Indonesian member of the Aquatic Animal Alliance. It co-organised the 2026 Animal March, which called for protection across species and an end to intensive farming.

sources.title: Animal March Suarakan 8 Tuntutan untuk Perlindungan dan Kesejahteraan Hewan | Cage Free Indonesia

notes: Cage Free Indonesia gives the full name and abbreviation. The alliance’s member roster links to the initiative’s Indonesian social account. Import review (2026-11-20): typed as an organisation; it was given as a programme with no parent.

name: Environment & Animal Society of Taiwan
summary: Campaigns in Taiwan on farmed animal welfare and animal testing. Its aquatic work includes public education on the practice of tying live fish and advocacy for stronger laws against shark finning.

name: Animal Welfare Awareness, Research and Education
summary: South Korean policy research group. It has surveyed public attitudes to the transport and slaughter of fish, developed tools for assessing pig welfare and advocated for oversight of zoos and aquariums.

sources.title: [보도자료] 어웨어 <어류 복지에 대한 국민인식조사 보고서> 발표
AfA appeal re ASEAN Leaders' Declaration on One Health Initiative (Global) AUG2023 (PUBLIC)

name: Nuru Animal Welfare Organization
summary: Kenyan organisation that studies farm animal welfare and runs workshops in schools, universities and communities. Animal Advocacy Africa’s directory identifies farmed finfish and chickens as its focal animals.
notes: The official site was readable in an indexed copy. Its domain did not resolve on a separate direct check.

name: Coalition of African Animal Welfare Organisations
summary: South Africa-based coalition that trains animal welfare advocates and works on legislation across Africa. Its farm animal agenda covers fish welfare in aquaculture, cages for laying hens and stalls for breeding sows.

sources.title: CAAWO | Advancing Animal Welfare & Human Wellbeing in Africa
Our Work at CAAWO | Advancing Animal Welfare in Africa

name: Sustainable Synergy Initiative
summary: Works with Ugandan government agencies, animal health specialists and farmers to draft welfare guidelines for farmed fish and chickens.

sources.title: Sustainable Synergy Initiative | Join Sustainable Farming Today
Animal Advocacy Africa’s 2025 Review and Strategic Priorities for 2025/26 — Animal Advocacy Africa

name: Animal Welfare League
aliases: Animal Welfare League Limited By Guarantee
summary: Works with Ghanaian poultry farmers and food companies on cage-free eggs and maintains an African cage-free directory. Its broader work on chickens and farmed fish includes projects in Ghana, Morocco, South Africa and Egypt.

sources.title: Animal Welfare League | Support Animal Welfare Today
CALL FOR VOLUNTEERS — Animal Welfare League
Our History | Learn & Support Animal Welfare — Animal Welfare League

name: Education for Africa Animal Welfare
summary: Dar es Salaam organisation that promotes cage-free poultry farming, runs dog vaccination projects and encourages plant-based eating in Tanzania.

sources.title: Past Movement Grants Recipients - Animal Charity Evaluators

notes: The organisation’s homepage and ACE’s grant register use different English spellings.

name: Utunzi Africa
summary: Kenyan organisation working on farmed, companion and wild animal welfare. It runs student seminars on cage-free poultry farming and engages food companies on cage-free egg sourcing.

sources.title: Past Movement Grants Recipients - Animal Charity Evaluators
pbos | The Public Benefit Organizations Regulatory Authority

name: International Cooperation Committee of Animal Welfare
summary: Develops farm animal welfare standards in China, assesses welfare and organises training and exchanges for the livestock sector.

sources.title: International Cooperation Committee of Animal Welfare

notes: Affiliated with the China Association for the Promotion of International Agricultural Cooperation, which records the committee’s registration in 2013.

name: Animal Empathy Philippines
summary: Supports farmed animal advocacy in the Philippines. Its Our Compassionate Choices project offers workplace workshops and guides on plant-based eating. Its Bayanihan programme includes farmed animals in disaster planning.

name: Farmed Animal Network Southeast Asia
summary: World Animal Protection network supporting farmed animal welfare groups in Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam. Partners work on farming practices, government policy and corporate commitments.

name: Çiftlik Hayvanlarını Koruma Derneği
summary: Runs two programmes in Türkiye. Kafessiz Türkiye asks companies to phase out eggs from caged hens. Future for Fish works with researchers and producers on farmed fish welfare.

sources.title: Çiftlik Hayvanları – Eziyetin Olmadığı Gelecek İçin

notes: The Kafessiz Türkiye campaign began in 2018. The association was established in 2020.

name: Future for Fish
summary: Studies the effects of electrical stunning on farmed sea bass and sea bream in Türkiye. It also offers research grants and shares findings with fish producers and aquaculture students.

sources.title: Future for Fish - Turkish | Promote Fish Welfare Today

name: Animals Now
summary: Investigates conditions on Israeli farms and campaigns for animal protection laws, including enforcement in fish farming. It also runs Challenge 22, an international programme for people trying a vegan diet.

sources.title: Sign the Petition to Protect the Fish | Animals Now

name: RSPCA Australia
aliases: Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Australia
summary: The national RSPCA office works with Australian governments and industry on animal welfare laws and practices, runs public education campaigns and oversees farm animal welfare certification.

name: RSPCA Certified
summary: Australian farm assurance programme that assesses farms against species-specific welfare standards. It publishes standards for Atlantic salmon, laying hens, meat chickens, pigs and turkeys.

name: Voiceless
summary: Australian funder of animal protection education, animal law and advocacy. Its grants have supported animal-free teaching in New Zealand, animal ethics education in the West Bank and legal training on captive lions in South Africa.

name: Association for Cephalopod Research ‘CephRes’ ETS
summary: Italian association that has trained researchers in the biology and care of laboratory cephalopods. It helped develop European guidance on the welfare of octopuses, squid, cuttlefish and nautiluses used in research.

sources.title: Guidelines for the care and welfare of Cephalopods in research - Guidelines

notes: Its research and training work is documented. Its primary domain did not resolve on a repeat check, so current operating status is unclear.

name: Nofima
summary: Norwegian food research institute. Its researchers helped develop the FISHWELL handbook, which gives farmers indicators for assessing Atlantic salmon welfare across rearing systems and handling procedures.

sources.title: English version of the FISHWELL Atlantic salmon welfare handbook - Nofima

notes: FISHWELL was a collaborative research project.

name: Mitchell & Cooper Ltd.
summary: UK catering equipment manufacturer that makes the Crustastun in East Sussex. The device is designed to stun lobsters, crayfish and crabs before cooking in professional kitchens.

sources.title: Crustastun - Humane Lobster Stunner | Commercial Kitchens

name: KRAV
summary: Swedish association that sets standards for its food label. Its rules cover livestock welfare and fishing practices, including how often fishing gear is hauled and how captured crabs are handled.

sources.title: KRAV – a Label for Organic Food
KRAV jubilerar – 40 år som gett EKO i Sverige - KRAV

name: Sea First Foundation
summary: Dutch foundation offering lessons on marine life, including the North Sea and coral reefs. Its Tuna Free campaign asks consumers and commercial kitchens to avoid tuna and discusses fish pain and overfishing.

sources.title: Vijf redenen om tonijnvrij te worden | Sea First

name: Animal Welfare Institute
summary: US organisation that advocates for animal protection through policy, research and education. Its work includes farmed fish welfare, the treatment of laboratory animals and worldwide campaigns on fishing and marine wildlife.

name: Humánny pokrok
summary: Slovak group that asks retailers to end sales of live carp and eggs from caged hens. It also campaigns on fast-growing broiler breeds and has published investigations into laying-hen farms.

sources.title: Humánny pokrok - združenie pre rozvoj ľudskosti a udržateľnosti

name: Dierenbescherming
aliases: Dutch Society for the Protection of Animals
Nederlandsche Vereeniging tot Bescherming van Dieren
summary: Runs Dutch animal ambulances and shelters and developed the Better Life label for farmed animal welfare. It has also asked the Dutch parliament to strengthen protection for fish during capture and killing.

sources.title: The Better Life label - Beter Leven keurmerk
Spreekbeurt over de geschiedenis van de Dierenbescherming

notes: Founded as a Hague association in 1864. It took its national name in 1877.

name: GAIA
aliases: Global Action in the Interest of Animals
summary: Belgian animal rights organisation working with companies and policymakers. Its campaigns include ending battery-egg sales, requiring stunning at slaughter and challenging an environmental permit for a sturgeon farm.

name: Dyrenes Beskyttelse
summary: Danish association that rescues and cares for abandoned pets and injured wildlife. It also advocates for farmed animals, including pigs raised and transported in Denmark.

sources.title: Denmark's oldest and largest animal welfare organization
Animal Protection Denmark | Eurogroup for Animals

name: Wakker Dier
summary: Amsterdam-based organisation campaigning on the welfare of animals in intensive livestock farming. It works with food businesses, informs consumers and advocates for changes to Dutch and European policy.

name: Deutscher Tierschutzbund
summary: Federation of German animal welfare associations and shelters. It supports shelters, runs rescue centres, works with street animals in Ukraine and advocates for animal protection in German and EU institutions.

sources.title: This is the German Animal Welfare Federation

name: Lumera Initiative
summary: Runs corporate cage-free egg campaigns in Zambia and works with poultry producers and local institutions on laying-hen welfare.

sources.title: Animal Advocacy Africa’s 2025 Review and Strategic Priorities for 2025/26 — Animal Advocacy Africa

name: Sibanye Animal Welfare and Conservancy Trust
summary: Zimbabwean trust that trains farmers on cage-free egg production, campaigns against sow stalls and teaches communities how to reduce conflict with elephants and predators.

sources.title: Running Cage-Free Projects in Africa: Case Studies of Three African Animal Advocacy Organisations — Animal Advocacy Africa

name: Animal Law Reform South Africa
summary: South African nonprofit that pursues animal protection through litigation, legal education and policy reform. Its programmes cover food systems, corporate accountability, wildlife and companion animals.

sources.title: About Us - Animal Law Reform South Africa

notes: The group began informally in 2014 and registered in 2017.

name: Lilongwe Society for the Protection and Care of Animals
summary: Lilongwe-based charity that operates a veterinary hospital and adoption shelter in Malawi. It works with the government on animal welfare education and enforcement of animal protection law.

name: Africa Network for Animal Welfare
summary: Kenya-based organisation that rescues and treats injured wildlife, supports dog vaccination and runs school animal welfare clubs. It also builds African networks for animal welfare policy.

sources.title: pbos | The Public Benefit Organizations Regulatory Authority

name: Aquatic Futures Africa
summary: Former Ugandan initiative that worked with fish farmers to develop more humane practices on large farms. Its incubator, Animal Advocacy Africa, subsequently reported that it had ceased operating.

sources.title: Animal Advocacy Africa’s 2024 Review and Plans for 2025 — Animal Advocacy Africa
Animal Advocacy Africa’s 2025 Review and Strategic Priorities for 2025/26 — Animal Advocacy Africa

name: Compromiso Verde
summary: Works with Peruvian egg producers and food companies on cage-free sourcing. It also seeks public policies to end the use of cages for laying hens.

name: Animal Libre
summary: Animal rights organisation founded in Chile, with teams in Argentina and Brazil. It offers free courses, conducts investigations and campaigns to end animal exploitation, including the use of animals in rodeos.

name: Sociedade Vegetariana Brasileira
summary: Brazilian nonprofit promoting plant-based eating. It works with individuals and institutions to replace animal protein, improve access to vegan products and share information about vegetarian diets.

name: Philippine Animal Welfare Society
summary: Runs a shelter for rescued dogs and cats and advocates for animal protection in the Philippines. Its Better Chicken Option campaign works on the welfare of chickens raised for meat.

sources.title: About PAWS • The Philippine Animal Welfare Society

notes: Import review (2026-11-20): the alias "PAWS" was left off because unrelated groups in other countries use it.

name: Perkumpulan Ayam Sejahtera Indonesia
summary: Indonesian membership coalition promoting cage-free egg production. It advocates for cage-free sourcing by Jakarta retailers and minimum welfare standards for laying hens.

name: Vietnam Animal Welfare Association
aliases: Hội Bảo vệ động vật Việt Nam
summary: Vietnamese animal protection association. Its chicken welfare project uses pilot farms and works with provincial governments and supply-chain partners to improve production practices.

sources.title: Giới thiệu – HỘI BẢO VỆ ĐỘNG VẬT VIỆT NAM – VAWA

name: Nepal Animal Welfare and Environment Society
summary: Nepalese organisation working on buffalo and poultry welfare policy, stray dog population management and animal welfare education in schools.

sources.title: Nawes Nepal – "Compassion for Animals, Commitment to Nature."

name: Animal Nepal
summary: Cares for street animals and working equines in Nepal, operates a sanctuary and advocates for animal welfare legislation, humane livestock transport and cage-free hen housing.

sources.title: Animal Nepal | Voice for the Voiceless Since 2009
About Us | Animal Nepal – Advocates for Animal Welfare

name: Animal Concerns Research & Education Society
summary: Singapore-based charity working on wildlife protection in Southeast Asia. It rescues and rehabilitates injured wildlife, campaigns against the wildlife trade and runs animal welfare education programmes.
